dialogues.speaker: Miner's Quarters Emergency Notice
dialogues.text: "Due to the sudden changes The Chasm is undergoing, all miners will be dispersed three days from now. You will be notified once work can resume. Please do not forget to take all your personal belongings with you!"

dialogues.speaker: Miner's Quarters Emergency Notice
dialogues.text: "Please deliver all letters and parcels to the Ministry of Civil Affairs for forwarding."
